'''Guido Kings''' (1965)<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |last=Bunke |first=Ulrich |date=2010-01-18 |title=Antrag für ein Graduiertenkolleg: Curvature, Cycles, and Cohomology – Geometric methods in analysis and arithmetic |url=http://www-app.uni-regensburg.de/Fakultaeten/MAT/GK/images/Vollantrag2.pdf |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210926225038/http://www-app.uni-regensburg.de/Fakultaeten/MAT/GK/images/Vollantrag2.pdf |archive-date=2021-09-26 |website=uni-regensburg.de}}</ref> is a German mathematician working in [[number theory]].

== Education and career ==
Kings studied mathematics at the [[University of Bonn]] between 1984 and 1989. He received his doctorate in 1994 and [[habilitation]] in 2000 at the [[University of Münster]]. In 2001, he held a research professorship at the [[Max Planck Institute for Mathematics]] in Bonn. He has been a full professor at the [[University of Regensburg]] since 2001.<ref name=":0" />

Kings has done research in [[arithmetic geometry]], the theory of [[Automorphic form|automorphic forms]], [[Iwasawa theory]], [[Polylogarithm|polylogarithms]], and [[Special values of L-functions|special values of ''L''-functions]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Forschung - Universität Regensburg |url=https://www.uni-regensburg.de/mathematik/mathematik-kings/forschung/index.html |access-date=2025-04-04 |website=www.uni-regensburg.de}}</ref>

He was the speaker of the research group ''Algebraic Cycles and L-Functions'' funded by the [[German Research Foundation]] (DFG).<ref>{{Cite web |last=Dietze |first=Rudolf |date=2005-02-25 |title=Ausnahmestellung der Regensburger Mathematik bekräftigt |url=https://idw-online.de/de/news102300 |access-date=2025-04-04 |website=idw-online.de}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Forschergruppe Algebraische Zykel und L-Funktionen |url=https://forschergruppe.app.uni-regensburg.de/ |access-date=2025-04-04 |website=forschergruppe.app.uni-regensburg.de}}</ref> Since 2012, he has been the speaker of the [[Collaborative Research Centres|collaborative research centre]] (SFB) ''Höhere Invarianten – Wechselwirkungen zwischen Arithmetischer Geometrie und Globaler Analysis'', also funded by the DFG.<ref>{{Cite web |title=SFB1085 - Higher Invariants |url=https://sfb-higher-invariants.app.uni-regensburg.de/index.php?title=Main_Page |access-date=2025-04-04 |website=sfb-higher-invariants.app.uni-regensburg.de}}</ref>

== Awards ==
Together with his coauthor [[Annette Huber-Klawitter]], Kings was the recipient of the award of the Universitätsgesellschaft Münster for young scientists in 1999.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Preisträger des Nachwuchsförderpreises |url=https://www.uni-muenster.de/Foerderer/foerdern/preistraegernwp.html |access-date=2025-04-04 |website=www.uni-muenster.de}}</ref> Kings and Huber-Klawitter were also invited speakers at the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] in Beijing in 2002.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Schedule of Invited Lectures |url=http://www.icm2002.org.cn/B/Schedule_by_Section.htm |access-date=2025-04-04 |website=www.icm2002.org.cn}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=colloquia |url=https://www.math.unipd.it/~conti/colloquia/colloquia_files/20180508_GuidoKings.html |access-date=2025-04-04 |website=www.math.unipd.it}}</ref>

Since 2012, he has been a [[Fellow of the American Mathematical Society]].<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=Forschungsmeldungen - Universität Regensburg |url=https://www.uni-regensburg.de/newsroom/presse/forschungsmeldungen/index.html?tx_news_pi1%5Baction%5D=detail&tx_news_pi1%5Bcontroller%5D=News&tx_news_pi1%5BhideDate%5D=0&tx_news_pi1%5Bnews%5D=23702&tx_news_pi1%5BsimpleList%5D=1&cHash=0d9da690e3967ba5be88b9d478bfa619 |access-date=2025-04-04 |website=www.uni-regensburg.de}}</ref>

In 2025, Kings and his former student Johannes Sprang received the Frontiers of Science Award for their joint paper ''Eisenstein-Kronecker classes, integrality of critical values of Hecke L-functions and p-adic interpolation'', which appeared in [[Annals of Mathematics]]).<ref name=":1" /><ref>{{Cite web |title=Meldungen aus der UDE: Neuer Schlüssel zur Welt der Zahlen – Frontiers of Science Award für Prof. Sprang |url=https://www.uni-due.de/2025-07-16-frontiers-of-science-award-fuer-johannes-sprang |access-date=2025-07-28 |website=www.uni-due.de}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last=Kings |first=Guido |last2=Sprang |first2=Johannes |title=Eisenstein–Kronecker classes, integrality of critical values of Hecke L-functions and p-adic interpolation |url=https://projecteuclid.org/journals/annals-of-mathematics/volume-202/issue-1/EisensteinKronecker-classes-integrality-of-critical-values-of-Hecke-L-functions/10.4007/annals.2025.202.1.1.short |journal=[[Annals of Mathematics]] |volume=202 |pages=1–109}}</ref>
